scheme_name: सब मिशन ऑन सीड एंड प्लांटिंग मटेरियल अंतर्गत बीजग्राम घटक
scheme_name_english: Sub Mission on Seed and Planting Material - Seed Village Component
department: Kisan Kalyan and Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Eligible farmers can receive quality seeds with subsidy. The official scheme page states up to 50% subsidy for food-grain crops and up to 60% for pulse and oilseed crops.
eligibility: Farmers of eligible categories holding up to 1 acre are eligible for the specified subsidy and training.
required_documents: B-1 land record copy or land-related document
application_process: Contact the concerned development block. Beneficiaries are selected on a first-come, first-served basis according to the agricultural season.
source_type: MP Government CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
